title: Gather at the Gulf
meta_description: Find the perfect 30A, FL vacation rental at ‘Gather at the Gulf’ a Luxury 7 Bedroom, 10 Bathroom vacation rental. Ideal for 16 guests, this home offers a private pool, gulf views & 6-seater golf cart.
description_expanded: Home Highlights - Gulf Views - Private Pool (Pool heating available Oct 1-May 1 for $30 per day) - 6-Seater Golf Cart & 6 Adult Bikes Included - Elevator - Short Walk to the Beach - Spacious Outdoor Space Located just one home back from the Gulf, the property offers sweeping water views from every level and effortless access to the beach. A short stroll leads to open, unrestricted shoreline, an uncommon and highly sought-after feature in Walton County. Designed with both comfort and entertaining in mind, the home features two expansive decks ideal for taking in Gulf breezes and unforgettable sunsets. Below, the generous backyard provides ample space for outdoor activities, gatherings, and relaxed coastal living, complemented by a private, shaded pool that serves as a tranquil retreat. Inside, an open and airy floor plan showcases European white oak flooring, crown molding, and custom luxury tile throughout. The chef-inspired kitchen is outfitted with premium Wolf and Sub-Zero appliances, offering both beauty and performance. Seven spacious bedrooms, each with its own en suite bath, allow the home to comfortably host large families or groups while maintaining privacy for all. An elevator services every level for ease and accessibility, and a professionally installed alarm system adds an extra layer of security and peace of mind. Perfectly positioned just one mile from Rosemary Beach and 30Avenue, this home places renowned dining, boutique shopping, and local entertainment within easy reach, whether by foot, bike, or car. Sleeping Arrangements First Floor King Bedroom - Private Bathroom with Shower King Bedroom - Private Bathroom with Shower Bunk Room - Queen Over Queen Bunk, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo Half Bathroom Second Floor Master Bedroom - King Bed - Private Bathroom with Shower Half Bathroom Third Floor King Bedroom - Private Bathroom with Shower Queen Bedroom - Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo King Bedroom - Private Bathroom with Shower Half Bathroom
